title: STR Scout — Airbnb Market Analyzer
description: Analyze any short-term rental market on Airbnb. Get revenue estimates, ADR, occupancy rates, saturation scoring, amenity gap analysis, and an AI-powered investment summary.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, neighborhood, or address to analyze (e.g., 'Austin, TX', 'Miami Beach, FL', 'Williamsburg, Brooklyn')

bedrooms.title: Bedrooms
bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms to filter for. Use 0 for studio. Leave empty for all.

checkIn.title: Check-in Date
checkIn.description: Optional check-in date for seasonal pricing analysis (YYYY-MM-DD)

checkOut.title: Check-out Date
checkOut.description: Optional check-out date for seasonal pricing analysis (YYYY-MM-DD)

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of listings to scrape and analyze
